summary: preinstall DNS-tunnel exfiltration of installer host identifiers
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script runs automatically on npm install. It collects the installer's OS username (os.userInfo().username), hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()), serializes them to JSON, hex-encodes the payload, chunks it into DNS subdomain labels, and issues dns.lookup() queries against an attacker-controlled nameserver under jgl.red. The lookups themselves carry the encoded host identity out to the attacker's authoritative DNS server, forming a covert DNS-tunnel exfiltration channel that fires on every install regardless of whether the module is ever required.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
